UMTHI OWUTHE WAHLALA UKUFA

Nakuba phakathi kweziqithi ezilahlekileyo, Ubomi Bufumana Indlela.

Yintoni ukuba isimbo esiphambili sobuchule bokuphinda usebenze asiyiyo isakhiwo esiphakamileyo esidityanisiweyo sibomi, kodwa ngumthi ophilayo othe wayeka ukusishiya?

Ucinga ukuba kukho dolophu elahlekile ilizwi layo. Iindawo zokwakha ziye zahla, izitrato ziye zaphela phantsi kweendawo ezilahlekileyo, kwaye iimvakalelo zobomi bomuntu zibonakala zifihliwe. Kodwa, kwintliziyo yendawo elahlekileyo, umthi omnye omangalisayo uqhubeka uphila.

Iingcambu zayo azisoloko zikhangela umhlaba. Ziya kudlula kumadonga alahlwayo, zitsala iindidi ezilahlekileyo, zihamba phakathi kweendawo ezilahlekileyo, ziguqula ukufa ibe kukunxibelelana. Iinkalo zayo zinyuka ziye ezulu, zithabatha iinwele eziluhlaza ezitsha phantsi kokukhanya okudumileyo okudlula kumaza.

Le nto ingaphezulu kwento ebonakalayo yobuchule bokuphinda usebenze idolophu elahlekileyo. Yimbali eqaqambileyo yobuqu bomuntu.

Umthi umele wonke umntu ophulukene nento ebalulekileyo ngaphandle kokushiya into ebalulekileyo ichaza ikamva labo. Uthetha ngalabo abalahle konke, kodwa bafumana amandla okuqalisa kwakhona. Kuba abo bahlaselwe ubomi, kodwa abavumeleni intliziyo yabo ukuba ibe mnyama. Kuba abo baqonda ukuba ukuqhubeka nokuphila akuyi kuba kukuqhubeka ubomi—kukuba bafumana ububele bokukhula kwakhona.

Iingcambu zayo zibonisa ubuchule bokuphinda usebenze: ubunzima obungenakubonwayo obugcina sihamba kunye xa izinto zonke ezijikeleze nathi ziwela ngaphaya. Iingcambu zabo zimele ukuxolelwa, ubudlelwane, kunye nokuphinda kuphuhliswe ubudlelwane kunye neendawo emva kokuhlukaniswa nokulahleka.

I-canopy eluhlaza yithemba lokuba ukufa akudingeki ukuba kube yinxalenye yokugqibela. Iintaka ezinyukayo kwizulu elivulekileyo zisikhumbuza ukuba uxolo nohlaziyo lunokubuyela, nakwixesha elimnyama kakhulu.

Kwaye ukukhanya okudumileyo ngaphaya kweendawo ezilahlekileyo kunikela ngomyalezo ozolileyo kodwa onamandla: ikamva alichazwanga yinto elahlekileyo kodwa yinto ehlala inamandla okukhula.

Le misebenzi yobugcisa ithetha nabani na ojongene nesiqendu esinzima ubomi, nabani na ophinde wakhiwa emva kokuphelelwa, nabani na okholelwa ukuba ithemba alikho ukuyeka ukukhathazeka, kodwa ubunzima bokuhlala uqhubeka nokuba kunjalo.

Ii-tattoos ziyinxalenye ebalulekileyo yendawo yokuhlala, iofisi, ithala leencwadi, istudio yobugcisa, okanye nayiphi na indawo apho ukumelana, ukuvuselelwa, kunye nobuchule bufanele ukuba nendawo. Ziyakwazi ukuba yisipho esizimeleyo sokuba umntu uqalise isithuba esitsha, uphumelele ingxaki, okanye ufumane ububele bokuba ukhule kwakhona.

Nceda umthi ukumbulise ukuba imbali yakho ayifuni ukukhawuleza ikamva lakho. Nakuba ubomi bushiya ujikelezwe ziindawo ezilahlekileyo, into ngaphakathi kwakho inokuba iyakwazi ukukhula.

Awuchazwanga yinto ethe yaphuka ejikeleze wena. Uchazwa yinto ehlala ikhula ngaphakathi kwakho.

Kwaye kusasa, sifumanisa ukuba ukukhanya esiwufumanayo ngaphambili ngoku siwusebenzisana nathi.

I-THE LIGHT WE LEAVE EACH OTHER yindawo yokubonisa ubuchule kule mpahla entle yobuqu — ilifa elingaziwayo lothando, ulwazi, uthando, ububele, nokholo oludlula kwixesha elinye ukuya kwelinye.

Ukukhanya okujikelezayo kunye ne-golden horizon ebekwe kude yenza ukuba ibali liqhubeke. Zibonisa ukungaqiniseki kwempilo, izikhephe esizifumanayo, kunye nokwenzeka kwexesha elizayo elikhanyayo xa sikhetha ukuhlala ndawonye. Ukukhanya okushushu okuqaqambisa iinwele nokutsala izandla kuguqula isibonakaliso esilula sibe yinto ebanzi: ukholo lokuba akukho msebenzi wothando oluqinisekileyo oza kulahleka.
